data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 1,186.259m. During 2023 the Syndicate recorded a gross prioryear adverse movement of GBP 388.016m (c.32.7% of opening reserves) driven predominantly by takeon reserves from a RITC (Syndicate 1301) and a large LPT with QBE, together with related reinsurance transactions. These reinsurance and portfolio transfer transactions materially increased gross reported reserves (strengthening), and also affected the reinsurance recoverables and net position.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement sourced from Note 18 'Technical provisions' (gross column). The claims development triangle is heavily affected by RITC/LPT take-ons which distort later development periods; RITC/LPT transactions are explicitly referenced and have been treated as contributors to the gross strengthening. No per-line-of-business gross prior-year movement breakout is provided; lob-level reserve movements therefore not populated. All monetary figures in the financial statements are presented in GBP '000; amounts here converted to millions.
